item.title: After years of talks, Israel to approve new international airport in Negev
item.description: Site in Ziklag, near Beersheba, was previously rejected for clashing with Air Force and Ben Gurion flight paths The post After years of talks, Israel to approve new international airport in Negev appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israel returns remains of dozens of slain Palestinians to Gaza, Hamas health ministry says
item.description: Hamas says 54 bodies and 66 other boxes of human remains taken by Red Cross to Gaza City's Shifa Hospital for identification; Israel does not comment The post Israel returns remains of dozens of slain Palestinians to Gaza, Hamas health ministry says appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US-Iran talks back on track after Trump warns Khamenei ‘should be very worried’
item.description: US and Iran say they'll meet in Oman Friday after reported dispute over Iran's demand that talks only cover nuclear issue; Rubio: Deal must include curbs on Iran's missiles, support for terror The post US-Iran talks back on track after Trump warns Khamenei ‘should be very worried’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: 3 men shot and killed in north as violent crime soars in Arab community
item.description: Cops, IDF probing alleged settler arson, vandalism by settlers in West Bank Christian town; no arrests * Ministers summoned to security cabinet meeting without being told subject of discussions The post 3 men shot and killed in north as violent crime soars in Arab community appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Hamas terrorist who murdered IDF surveillance soldier Noa Marciano killed in strike
item.description: IDF says Muhammad Issam Hassan al-Habil, a Hamas cell commander, was targeted in Gaza City's Shati Camp; Shin Bet says he 'brutally murdered' Marciano at Gaza City hospital The post Hamas terrorist who murdered IDF surveillance soldier Noa Marciano killed in strike appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: UK jury finds pro-Palestinian activists who stormed Elbit factory not guilty
item.description: Palestine Action members acquitted of aggravated burglary, with one also found not guilty of causing grievous bodily harm despite being filmed striking policewoman with sledgehammer The post UK jury finds pro-Palestinian activists who stormed Elbit factory not guilty appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Terror charges added to indictment against man accused of killing Israeli Embassy staffers
item.description: Defendant in murder of Yaron Lischinsky and Sarah Milgrim hit with four additional counts of terrorism that US attorney in DC notes 'carry a mandatory life sentence' The post Terror charges added to indictment against man accused of killing Israeli Embassy staffers appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Mamdani appoints head of progressive Jewish group to lead antisemitism office
item.description: Phylisa Wisdom of NY Jewish Agenda to head city's Office to Combat Antisemitism; her group is Zionist, unlike Mamdani, though she has also expressed opposition to IHRA definition of antisemitism The post Mamdani appoints head of progressive Jewish group to lead antisemitism office appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Australian teen charged with making death threats against Herzog ahead of upcoming visit
item.description: Suspect, who also reportedly threatened Trump, faces up to 10 years in prison for threatening 'a foreign head of state and internationally protected person' on social media The post Australian teen charged with making death threats against Herzog ahead of upcoming visit appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Jewish community tells Man City coach to ‘focus on soccer’ after he decries ‘genocide in Palestine’
item.description: Local Jewish group say remarks by Pep Guardiola 'especially galling given his total failure... to display any solidarity with the Jewish community' after deadly Yom Kippur attack on synagogue The post Jewish community tells Man City coach to ‘focus on soccer’ after he decries ‘genocide in Palestine’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.
